BiblicalUsage: Tachrea was an Israelite, a son of Micah of the family of Saul, named in the genealogy of those who lived in Jerusalem after the exile. He is named once, and nothing more is told of him. His father's name is the same as the prophet Micah's, but this Micah is Saul's descendant, not the prophet.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the post-exile list keeps men like Tachrea for a reason: after the return, the family of Saul was still counted, and its sons were still named.
